translation.title: Ammonium Lactate Lotion
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for temporary relief of dry, rough skin (xerosis), ichthyosis vulgaris, and the itching caused by these conditions.
translation.usage: Use it twice a day or as directed by a doctor or pharmacist. Shake well, apply to the affected area and rub in gently so it absorbs well.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, or in the eyes, on the lips or on mucous membranes. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, or if you are breastfeeding. Avoid or minimize use on skin exposed to natural or artificial sunlight (including the face). For external use only. If symptoms worsen after use, stop immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Adverse reactions may occur - sometimes temporary stinging, a burning sensation, erythema (red patches), skin peeling, and other reactions such as redness, eczema, petechiae (pinpoint bleeding spots), dryness and excessive pigmentation. Store at room temperature.
